pipeline_steps.description: Retrieve annotated N-/O-glycosylation sites per protein from the GlyGen MCP server.
pipeline_steps.name: GlyGen glycosite lookup

pipeline_steps.description: Fetch the canonical UniProt sequence for the sequon check and numbering reconciliation.
pipeline_steps.name: Canonical sequence fetch

pipeline_steps.description: Reconcile each variant against the canonical residue (else 'unmapped'), then classify by an N-X-S/T sequon delta and GlyGen O-glycosite loss.
pipeline_steps.name: Harmonize numbering + classify LOG/GOG

pipeline_steps.description: Join AlphaMissense from ProtVar's canonical isoform (accession-keyed, batched) and ClinVar significance from BioMCP via ProtVar's allele-specific rsID, verified against the canonical protein change.
pipeline_steps.name: Annotation join (BioMCP)

pipeline_steps.description: Rank GOG/LOG above none (unmapped last); within by AlphaMissense pathogenicity then ClinVar significance. Emit the candidate table.
pipeline_steps.name: Rank + report

algorithmic_error.alphamissense_coverage: AlphaMissense covers canonical isoforms; a variant on an accession it does not score returns no value rather than a substitute
algorithmic_error.clinvar_source_filter: ProtVar's clinicalSignificances aggregates several sources; only ClinVar-sourced calls are reported as ClinVar (an Ensembl-only call is not a ClinVar submission), and a BioMCP record is used only when its own hgvs_p matches the canonical change
algorithmic_error.expression_check: recipe step 3 (demote candidates not expressed in the tissue of interest) is inert here — no tissue/disease context supplied
algorithmic_error.numbering: variants whose stated wild-type residue does not match the canonical UniProt residue are reported as 'unmapped' rather than classified
algorithmic_error.ranking: a triage heuristic (AlphaMissense pathogenicity + ClinVar), not a validated pathogenicity score
algorithmic_error.scope: single-residue missense only; indels, frameshift, splice and nonsense variants are not classified
algorithmic_error.variant_match_ambiguity: AlphaMissense is taken from ProtVar's canonical isoform for the accession under analysis, so it cannot drift onto another transcript's residue; a ProtVar reference-residue WARN, or a change that is not SNV-reachable, is refused as unmapped rather than annotated

parametric_domain.value: GOG/LOG above none (unmapped last); within by AlphaMissense pathogenicity then ClinVar significance
not applied — no tissue/disease context in the input

contributors.name: Claude (Anthropic), driven by the sci-ai-enabler recipe 'interpret-glycosylation-altering-variants'

provenance_domain.name: Interpret variants that gain or lose glycosylation sites — reference run

usability_domain: Flags protein-coding missense variants that create (GOG) or destroy (LOG) N-/O-linked glycosylation sites, joins ClinVar + AlphaMissense, and ranks candidates where altered glycosylation is a plausible disease mechanism.
Reference run over a 7-variant SERPINC1/IFNGR2 panel; 4 glycosylation-altering hits.
